pages.title: Incense Burner
pages.text: Right-clicking an Incense Burner with either a $(l:herbs/pounded_herbs)Pounded Herb$() or a $(l:herbs/dried_herbs)Dried Herbs$() will provide you with a status effect depending on the type of herb provided to it.

pages.title: Item Burning
pages.text: If a Deteriorated Sacrificial Rune Block is placed underneath the Incense Burner, you gain access to burning certain items with mystical flames.$(br)Sometimes this results in just regular items getting turned into a burnt variant, but sometimes it may lead to some mystical transmogrification.
